goal: Establish whether the Pucks free-shipping threshold is strictly "above ₪100" (cart logic > 100) or effectively "at least ₪100" (>= 100) by quoting an anonymous cart whose item subtotal is exactly ₪100.
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome + ChromeDriver session (scripts/browser-research.mjs). Anonymous cart only; no order, payment, login, account creation, street address or bot-challenge bypass. Session/cart identifiers are stripped from this record.

trackedSku.name: lavazza crema e gusto classico-250 גרם קפה טחון
trackedSku.cartCheck: 3 × 250 g cart displayed a ₪90.00 subtotal before delivery selection

boundaryProblem: The only tracked Pucks coffee SKU costs ₪30 per 250 g pack, so a coffee-only cart subtotal is a multiple of ₪30: ₪90 (3 packs, paid delivery observed) and ₪120 (4 packs, free delivery observed). Exactly ₪100 cannot be reached with the tracked coffee alone.

combinationsChecked: 3 × 30 + 10 = 100 — the ₪10 item is out of stock

blocker: No in-stock combination of the tracked coffee and the surveyed fillers reaches exactly ₪100.00 item subtotal, and a mixed-cart filler quote would not unambiguously describe the tracked coffee cart rule. The exact boundary therefore remains unobserved.
policyDecision: The checked-in policy keeps the vendor's own strict wording (thresholdSemantics: "above"): a cart of exactly ₪100 is not treated as free. This can only under-promise free shipping, never over-promise it, and for coffee-only carts the strict boundary has no practical effect because the subtotal jumps from ₪90 (paid) to ₪120 (free). The gap is documented in src/lib/policies.js and docs/SOURCES.md.
notes: The interactive shop filter and category checkboxes did not produce a reliable filtered list in the headless session; cheap products were read from the unfiltered rendered shop page.
The ₪22 capsules and ₪45/₪75 bean listings are not part of the tracked product scope and were surveyed only as potential cart fillers.
